fusions.name: Thrown to the Pack
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in both hands and hurls it 3 tiles, which deals 12 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Rallying Roar
fusions.desc: Beats your chest and howls, which deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Loud in Front
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground and bellows, pulling up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. For 8 seconds a packmate fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckle-Runner
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver you attack 5% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises 5%.
